prospective_plan.timing_summary: median of per-shape paired block medians; family median of individual ratios
prospective_plan.persistent_failure: Reject; no unchanged retry or relaxed gate.
prospective_plan.resources: Full results/physical reads/statistics exact; common-case work and all category current/peak/acquired nonincreasing, meaningful target allocation traffic reduction. Changed-label mismatches may count bounded extra comparison work, separately disclosed.
prospective_plan.compiled_cost: Proportional66, fixed text/data/BSS distinct from query memory.
prospective_plan.limits: Synthetic same-device timings; no universal/live/concurrent/RSS/physicalARM claim. All blocks retained. No retrospective change to217.

timing.interpretation: Paired median ratios on finite native queries and this shared host; all blocks retained including substantial absolute drift. No causal explanation of host variability or universal speed guarantee.

resources.work: Nonincreasing on measured equal-label baseline/timing/broad comparisons; changing-label fallback explicitly charges its additional bounded comparison.
resources.memory: All measured category current/peak/acquired nonincreasing. Lower acquired means cumulative allocation traffic, not a lower live peak. Stack and process RSS not measured.

compiled_cost_scope: Standalone default C consumers; proportional fixed text/data/BSS growth under66, separate from query RAM or full Netdata executable.

limitations: Finite synthetic evidence; no live Netdata/concurrent load/RSS/physical ARM throughput or arbitrary-input proof.
No new language coverage or compatibility exception. Existing original strict/order/numeric failures remain failures.
